def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import openpyxl
    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('data/archeology/input/climateMeasurements.xlsx', read_only=True, data_only=True)
    ws = wb.active
    rows = list(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))
    # Row index 4 has units (ppm), row index 5 has actual header
    header = rows[5]
    data_rows = rows[6:]
    df = pd.DataFrame(data_rows, columns=header)
    wb.close()
    return df

import numpy as np

def process(climate_proper, malta_date_range):
    # Get the climate data with K and Age_ky columns
    df = climate_proper[['Age_ky', 'K']].dropna()
    df = df.sort_values('Age_ky').reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Malta BP dates: 6412 BP and 6005 BP
    # BP = years before 1950; ka = thousands of years before 1950
    # So 6412 BP = 6.412 ka, 6005 BP = 6.005 ka
    first_bp = malta_date_range['first_bp'].iloc[0]
    last_bp = malta_date_range['last_bp'].iloc[0]
    
    first_ka = first_bp / 1000.0
    last_ka = last_bp / 1000.0
    
    # Linearly interpolate K at these two time points
    k_first = float(np.interp(first_ka, df['Age_ky'].values, df['K'].values))
    k_last = float(np.interp(last_ka, df['Age_ky'].values, df['K'].values))
    
    avg_k = (k_first + k_last) / 2.0
    
    return pd.DataFrame({
        'first_ka': [first_ka],
        'last_ka': [last_ka],
        'K_at_first': [round(k_first, 6)],
        'K_at_last': [round(k_last, 6)],
        'average_K': [round(avg_k, 4)]
    })

operators.customDisplayName: Interpolate Potassium (K in ppm) values at the first (6412 BP = 6.412 ka) and last (6005 BP = 6.005 ka) Malta radiocarbon dates using linear interpolation on the climate dataset (Age_ky vs K columns). Computes the average of the two interpolated K values.

def process(climate_proper, malta_date_range):
    import numpy as np
    
    df = climate_proper[['Age_ky', 'K']].dropna()
    df = df.sort_values('Age_ky')
    
    first_bp = malta_date_range['first_bp'].iloc[0]
    last_bp = malta_date_range['last_bp'].iloc[0]
    
    # Convert BP to ka (1 BP = 0.001 ka)
    first_ka = first_bp / 1000.0
    last_ka = last_bp / 1000.0
    
    # Linear interpolation
    K_first = np.interp(first_ka, df['Age_ky'].values, df['K'].values)
    K_last = np.interp(last_ka, df['Age_ky'].values, df['K'].values)
    
    avg_K = (K_first + K_last) / 2.0
    avg_K_rounded = round(avg_K, 4)
    
    return pd.DataFrame({
        'first_ka': [first_ka],
        'last_ka': [last_ka],
        'K_at_first': [K_first],
        'K_at_last': [K_last],
        'average_K': [avg_K],
        'average_K_rounded': [avg_K_rounded]
    })

operators.customDisplayName: Interpolate Potassium (K in ppm) at first (6412 BP = 6.412 ka) and last (6005 BP = 6.005 ka) Malta dates using numpy linear interpolation on Age_ky vs K from climate data. Computes and rounds average to 4 decimal places.
